                            Explanation of Table
 
                                          
  Columns 1 and 2 list U.S. Code titles and sections in ascending order.
       The letter "A" in column 1 means Appendix.
  Column 3 contains special information as follows:
       "new"      means a new section or new note, or all new text of an
                  existing section or note.
       "nt"       means note.
       "prec"     means preceding.
       "fr"       means a transfer from another section.
       "to"       means a transfer to another section.
       "omitted"  means the section is omitted.
       "repealed" means the section is repealed.
  Columns 4, 5, and 6 contain Public Law, Section, and Statutes-at-Large
       citations.
